composition: Directory tables, mobile cards, creation dialogs, column order and store form sections retained. Customer error states now replace the false empty-list message; existing role/store permissions are reflected in customer creation controls.

fixes.before: BAZAAR appeared both as brand caption and fallback page title
fixes.after: Page title uses the existing localized Suppliers label in RU/KG/EN.

fixes.before: Raw hardware URL segment was displayed in Russian/Kyrgyz UI
Escape closed the menu and left focus on document.body; reopening with Enter no longer worked
fixes.after: Escape and cancellation of confirmations restore the actual More button. Confirmation actions run after menu focus restoration; action order, dimensions and tooltip are unchanged.

fixes.before: A denied request displayed both an access error and an empty-customer message; no retry action
fixes.after: An accessible error alert with retry replaces the list while a request is in error; choosing an assigned store recovers the normal view

fixes.before: Staff/cashier direct links exposed an Add button and the creation alias could open a form even though the server denies these roles
fixes.after: The existing manageCustomers policy controls creation and the add alias; an assigned store is also required for Add/Save buttons and submission. Server authorization is unchanged.

fixes.before: Stores, suppliers and compliance contained placeholder labels such as Notes hint, Section basic and Card overview
fixes.after: Labels, hints, actions and feedback describe the existing functions; Kyrgyz supplier directory heading also translated

fixes.before: The add=1 flag remained in the URL and changing a filter reopened a blank creation form after a successful save or cancellation
fixes.after: Opening the form consumes only add=1; the store and other filters remain, and later search changes do not reopen the form

testEnvironment.finalBrowserState: Admin, RU, dark theme; preferences restored; supplier list open for continuation

productionBuild.result: passed; type/lint checks and all 125 static pages completed

limitations: This is one route family checkpoint, not completion of the full 97-route redesign.
No physical printer, Connector, fiscal or payment provider was used.
Permanent deletion was not executed in the browser; the reported database suites do not imply complete deletion coverage.
No forced browser network/server error injection; rendered error/retry coverage still pending.
delivery: Local playground only, no main merge, push or production deployment

crossFamilyObservations.observation: During role verification, plain /login led to /dashboard, whose data request was denied. Role navigation correctly hides dashboard. Authentication route handling needs its own verification before the complete redesign can be accepted.
